claims: Chuck Norris criticized the Boy Scouts of America for allowing gay leaders.
Chuck Norris warned that Obama’s reelection would bring "1,000 years of darkness".
According to The Guardian, Chuck Norris claimed in 2012 that the Boy Scouts of America was bowing to a "pro-gay" agenda from the White House.
Chuck Norris appeared in a 2012 video with his wife Gena predicting 1,000 years of darkness if Barack Obama was reelected.
According to PBS, Chuck Norris endorsed Donald Trump in 2016.
According to PBS, Chuck Norris wrote columns supporting Donald Trump.

According to Virginia Tech, in 1996 Chuck Norris filed a lawsuit against two karate studios bearing his name accusing them of discriminating against Black people by charging higher fees and discouraging membership.
According to Virginia Tech, Chuck Norris settled a 99-year licensing agreement lawsuit against studios in 1997 after accusations of breach of contract.
According to Radiology Today, Chuck Norris took legal action against MRI manufacturers over claims they poisoned his wife.
